{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ewok religion''' was the traditional spirituality of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a small forested [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Endor (planet)/Legends|same name]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> The Ewoks worshipped many different supernatural beings, known either as "[[Deity/Legends|gods]]" or "spirits." In some cases, those deities were humanoid in shape, others were animalistic, and others were associated with "natural" forces on the moon, such as the [[Tree/Legends|trees]], the wind, the rain, and the night.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The Ewoks saw their deities as close to them, existing within the same world; they would frequently call upon the spirits and address prayers to them.<ref name="TAOT">''[[The Adventures of Teebo: A Tale of Magic and Suspense]]''</ref> Since Endor was a forest moon, Ewoks had a tendency to worship and mythologize trees.<ref name="HEST">''[[How the Ewoks Saved the Trees: An Old Ewok Legend]]''</ref>

==Tree worship==
[[File:Tree_worsphip.png|thumb|250px|A group of Ewoks chanting to the trees]]
{{Quote|O Tree, our Father, old as moons,<br />Listen to our plea.<br />Lead our spirits when we meet<br />Our deadly enemy.|Logray|<ref name="TAOT" />}}
Ewoks regarded the Endorian trees as living spirit who watched over them and protected them. For that reason, it was against their religion to do harm to ancient tree, let alone to cut it down.<ref name="HEST" /> However, that religious prescript did not prevent Ewoks such as [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]] to work as woodcutters.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|chukhatrok|Chukha-Trok}}</ref> The Ewoks thought that tree had a language of their own, although it could only be heard and understood by young Ewoks under normal circumstances.<ref name="HEST" /> The tallest tree on the moon, which was referred to as [[Father Tree]], was thought to lead the Ewoks in battle. Another spirit known as the [[Forest Father]] would hear the prayers of the [[Wokling/Legends|woklings]] who were lost in the woods.<ref name="TAOT" /> Yet another prominent entity was the [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Great Spirit Tree]], which was thought to have been the original tree on Endor.<ref name="GSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

==Spirits and gods==
{{Quote|I do believe that they think I am some sort of god.|C-3PO|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
[[File:This_Golden_god.png|thumb|left|The Ewoks mistook C-3PO for "the Golden One."]]
Generally speaking, the spirits associated with the night were perceived as malevolent: [[Denlett]] was thought to often lure Ewoks into walking off platforms in the dark, falling to their death, while [[Heesh]] was known for trying to make its victims fall asleep.<ref name="GCG" /> More importantly, the evil god par excellence was called the "[[Night Spirit/Legends|Night Spirit]]." According to the believers, that god would sometimes manifest as a ghostly apparition.<ref name="GSWU2" /> A group of mysterious aliens with a toothy grin known as the [[Wizard of the Night Spirit|Wizards of the Night Spirit]] were also thought to serve the evil entity. However, not all spirits of the night were considered malicious. [[Jahjee]], for one, had a more neutral role, as he would bring the sleeping Ewoks their dreams.<ref name="GCG" />

Occasionally, the Ewoks would mistake extraordinary offworlders for some of their gods. This notably happened when the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] set foot on Endor during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CWA5">{{CWACite|5|What Goes Up... (comic story)}}</ref> The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was also mistaken for "the [[Golden One/Legends|Golden One]]," whose coming among the Ewoks had been foretold by prophets.<ref name="ROJN">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'']]</ref>
